issues.reason: The reviewer's own q2 concedes there is no licensed slot for a change-of-value 'to <new time>', and in that gap both emitted atoms are true and non-over-asserted; the 'non-eventive entity' half is undercut by the reviewer's own reading of the deadline as an altered scheduled occurrence (which is what licenses (Patient sk_extend_1 sk_deadline_1)), and Time terms attach directly to exactly such an occurrence-denoting noun's witness.

gaps_confirmed: change-of-value verb with a 'to <new time>' argument ('extended the deadline to Oct. 17') — no licensed slot for the new value: Goal is the spatial 'to', and Time on the extend event would say when the extending happened

a definite 'the deadline' bridged to an earlier 'by <time>' adjunct in the same sentence — bridging licenses only PartOf, so nothing links the deadline entity to the TimeAtMost that adjunct put on the completion event
new_gaps: a bare capitalized plural naming a collective political actor ('Republicans') acting as one body — the determiner test routes bare plurals to the generic/rule form and the group route is stated for definite/counted plurals, so neither covers it
notes: Alternatives to the parser's choice are worse: Time on sk_extend_1 would falsely date the extending, and re-stating the deadline as a second TimeAtMost on the completion event would silently overwrite the August bound. The parse is left untouched.
